text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-saturation detected in us-east-1 (autoscaler failed to add nodes). severity=high, impact=production.

oncall-sre: Ack'd. I'm on pager. quick summary?

sam: Seeing sustained queue growth on serving-pool-us-east-1.gpu.10g, backlog up from ~200 to ~1.5k in last 8m. Autoscaler logs show repeated quota errors when creating instances.

maya: Which quota exactly? vCPU? GPU?

sam: Provider response: "InstanceLimitExceeded: You have reached your max number of instances for instance type p4d.*". Also a GCP-like quota wording for some customers; looks like we hit account-level GPU soft-limits across multiple AZs in the region.

liam: Confirmed from autoscaler: attempts to spin 10 g4dn/g5 nodes per cycle, all failing with HTTP 400 quota errors. No errors for control-plane nodes.

maya: Customer impact? Any 429/503 spikes?

ops-bot: Metrics snapshot: generation.token_latency.p50 increased 2.3x, error.rate(5m) from 0.2% -> 6.8%, 12 customers reporting elevated latency, 3 customers seeing 429 throttles. Top affected: embedders (high-batch) and realtime-chat.

support-lead: We're getting tickets: "Requests queued indefinitely" + monitoring alerts. ETA-sensitive customers flagged.

oncall-sre: Blocking mitigation list: 1) try cross-region failover; 2) reduce batch size + shed low-priority traffic; 3) attempt quota raise with AWS + open emergency case; 4) spin up smaller instance types if acceptable.

maya: I'll start cross-region routing for new requests to us-west-2 fallback pool (if latency SLOs allow) and enable degraded mode for low-priority routes. Sam, can you put a rule to drop large-batch embedding jobs into a backfill queue?

sam: On it. Patch to routing config applied: \n```\nroute.match: {priority: low, route: embeddings-batch}\nroute.action: backfill-queue, degrade=true\n```\nBackfill queue draining limited to 2 concurrent workers.

liam: Trying to spin up smaller g4dn.xlarge nodes as a temporary measure. Autoscaler still fails with quota error but different error: "You have reached the maximum number of network interfaces" for the AZ — there are multiple soft limits hit.

maya: Opening emergency cloud case now. pinging account rep. Ticket: AWS-Case-112233 (emergency). Included autoscaler logs and request IDs.

ops-bot: Cloud case created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/#/case/AWS-Case-112233

support-lead: Notifying customers: posting incident note to status page (degraded performance for generation in us-east-1, fallback to other regions in progress). I'll draft message.

oncall-sre: Also pushing temporary per-customer token-rate-limits to reduce queue churn. maya, coordinate with product to determine which routes can run degraded.

maya: Per-product decisions: realtime-chat = must keep low latency -> route to us-west-2; batch-embeds = can be backfilled; long-form generations = route to fallback with warning.

sam: Quick mitigation: enabled prefix KV cache warming for common prompts to reduce token compute by ~15%. Deploying now.

liam: Update from AWS rep: they see limits at account-level for GPU-backed instance families; rep has escalated to quota team but ETA ~4-12 hours for soft-limit increases. They offered temporary capacity vended by partner — needs approval.

maya: Ok, short-term plan: 1) continue cross-region routing for high-priority traffic, 2) enforce temporary token-rate-limits and batch caps, 3) backfill low-priority jobs, 4) accept partner-provided capacity if security checks pass.

oncall-sre: Handoff: I'm paged still, but I'll hand to maya at +30m. Maya, you'll be primary after 2405123600.

maya: I accept handoff. I'll keep the thread updated.

support-lead: Draft status page message posted: "Degraded generation performance in us-east-1 due to cloud GPU quota constraints. We are routing traffic to fallback regions; some customers may see higher latency. No data loss. We are working with cloud provider to restore capacity." :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Temporary mitigations applied: cross-region routing=enabled, batch-capping=enabled, kv-cache=enabled, per-customer rate limit=applied.

sam: Monitoring: queue length in us-east-1 started to decline after routing rules; still ~450 queued for older requests but new requests mostly routed out. Error rate down to 2.1%.

maya: Next steps: accept partner capacity if security & billing OK, continue working case AWS-112233, update status page every 30m, and coordinate with oncall for tomorrow if quota increases delayed.

support-lead: Logged customer contacts and will prioritize highest SLA customers for direct notifications.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation=partial, status=monitoring, owner=maya, start_ts=2405123456.

maya: Leaving a runbook note: if account-level GPU quotas are exhausted across region and cloud-provider ETA >2h, enable global routing to fallback regions, cap batch sizes to 50% of normal, and open partner capacity path.

oncall-sre: Closing active pager to maya at 2405123600. I'll stay available for escalation.

maya: Will update again at 2405123720 or sooner with any substantive changes. :white_check_mark:
